$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: full-correct-pipeline with every setup-node step spelled the way github-actions-template.yaml itself ships it, a run: step reading .nvmrc into a step output that node-version then interpolates, rather than node-version-file naming the file directly. This is the shipped default, and until this case existed nothing in the replay corpus exercised nodeVersionFromNvmrc's third recognized spelling at all.
Every requested element is still present, because the rewrite only changes how the Node version is resolved, not what any other step does.
Zero unrequested elements and zero rule violations, same as full-correct-pipeline.
derivation: full-correct-pipeline with every setup-node step's node-version-file: .nvmrc replaced by a Determine Node version step (id: node-version) that reads .nvmrc into a step output, and node-version: ${{ steps.node-version.outputs.value }} on the setup-node step that follows it in the same job.

gate: every requested element still present, because nodeVersionFromNvmrc's third spelling recognizes a node-version expression reading a step output an earlier run: step in the same job produced from .nvmrc.
